snippet.title: Grow Wild | Trailer | Transform Empty Landscapes Into Thriving Ecosystems
snippet.description:
Grow Wild is a cosy relaxing nature simulator where you grow real-world plants and trees to attract wildlife.

You'll join the Grow Wild Nature Club and travel the globe transforming empty landscapes into thriving biodiverse ecosystems using real ecological principles.

The exuberant Professor Vicky Sponge will guide you on your global adventure across 5 unique biomes as you rewild 15 diverse landscapes - experiencing how your actions shape ecosystems over decades. 

You’ll look at lizards, pick up pine cones, balance biomes, photograph falcons, sow seeds, trim trees, follow a frog, hide in a bush, surprise a snake, wait for a weasel, chat about chiff chaffs, and experience the magic, joy, and wonder of the natural world.

📄Sign up for playtesting - https://forms.gle/MifCXrrKhKjefoePA

🎮 Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230260/Grow_Wild/

💬 Join our community on Discord - https://discord.gg/B9S8AZCXt4

🌱 Game website -  https://www.grow-wild-game.com
